gen-silkscreen-gf-hepta-slab: Hepta Slab stretches its words out with bookish dignity, open counters letting each line breathe. Hepta Slab handles the steady reading, whereas Silkscreen puts its lo-fi, retro spacing to work on a few big letters.
gen-tourney-inter: Inter lays down big, hollow-reed counters and a tall lowercase that glides along like a smooth tube. Tourney does bold, athletic, wide-tracked punch; Inter does the sustained sans reading.
gen-gf-paprika-poppins: Lowercase letters that fill the line like capitals give Paprika its commanding, scattered look. Poppins would start to compete if the body went large, since its sturdy lowercase already stands tall.
gen-gf-revalia-poppins: A lowercase g with an open lower curve gives Revalia a relaxed stride across widely spaced letters. Poppins then keeps its lines ruler-straight and its curves rope-loose, leaving the drama to the heading.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-poppins: Wide stencil bridges cut Snowburst One into bold, tall lowercase pieces. Poppins then moves down a full column in sans strokes drawn like neon tube, smooth and modern, nothing flickering.
gen-gf-tektur-poppins: Poppins brings rope-loose curves and a tall, sturdy body beneath the pipe-cleaner strokes and outsized lowercase of Tektur. Make the heading generous in size and the body quite modest.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-poppins: Commanding from the first glance, Tilt Neon splays its c terminal wide. What stands out is the tube-like constant stroke of the heading against sans-serif Poppins with its rope-loose curves.
gen-gf-autour-one-fs-fira-sans: Expressive and bold, Autour One keeps one clean channel into each round letter. Fira Sans brings a larger-than-usual x-height, with s curves open wide at both ends and no thick-thin shift.
gen-audiowide-fs-asap: A tube-like thickness holds through every bend of Audiowide, its tall lowercase set like tiles with wide grout. Asap carries the text smoothly, with open-arc c forms and near-capital height.
gen-eater-work-sans: Eater is dark and aggressive, with moderate thick-thin modulation and wide gaps between letters and short ascenders. Work Sans then reads on in plain sans lines whose width never shifts.
